subject: Maxxing
title: What does maxxing mean? Dictionary.com's 2026 Word of the Year
answer: Maxxing means pursuing an activity to the fullest or optimizing some part of your life. It works on its own ("I'm maxxing everything") or as a suffix, as in looksmaxxing or sleepmaxxing. Dictionary.com named maxxing its 2026 Word of the Year.
body:
Dictionary.com traces maxxing to maximum, maximize and max, and to the gaming term min-maxing, which means building a character's strengths so its weaknesses don't matter. The word picked up an extra "x" and first spread on Reddit and other forums. People also type it as "maxing," but the double-x spelling is the one Dictionary.com chose.

The most familiar form is looksmaxxing, trying to improve your physical appearance. Dictionary.com said searches for looksmaxxing "skyrocketed in early 2026" and searches for maxxing on its own "have risen exponentially over the past year." Other examples it lists include tokenmaxxing (using as much AI at work as possible), nonnamaxxing (adopting an Italian grandmother's habits) and cozymaxxing.

The other words on Dictionary.com's 2026 shortlist were affordability, data center, odyssey and unc.
in_the_news: Dictionary.com named maxxing its 2026 Word of the Year on Oct. 25, 2026.
